The safety of FILSPARI was evaluated in PROTECT (NCT03762850), a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled clinical study in adults with IgAN.

The Applicant has submitted the results of an interim analysis of an ongoing, adequate, and well-controlled phase 3 study in adults with biopsy-verified primary IgAN as principal support for effectiveness.

design.text: Randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, multicenter study; patients randomized 1:1 to sparsentan (400 mg once daily) or irbesartan (300 mg once daily active control).

citations.quote: The PROTECT study is a randomized, double-blind, active-controlled, multicenter study in patients with biopsy-proven IgAN, estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) \ge 30 mL/min/1.73 m^2, and total urine protein \ge 1.0 g/day on a maximized stable dose of RAS inhibitor treatment.

Patients were randomized (1:1) to either FILSPARI (400 mg once daily following 200 mg once daily for 14 days) or irbesartan (300 mg once daily following 150 mg once daily for 14 days). Rescue immunosuppressive treatment could be initiated per investigator discretion during the trial, but use of SGLT2 inhibitors was prohibited.
